name: unshorten.me (short-link expansion service)
operator: unshorten.me (operator not identified on the site)
tier_rationale: No identifiable operator, no terms of service page (checked 2026-11-26), ad-funded; the council recorded tier unknown for P070 (A8): never default, excluded at TLP:AMBER and above.

reliability.justification: Small single-purpose service without documented guarantees; the answer is the service's own fetch of the short link at query time.

json_api.title: unshorten.me JSON lookup https://unshorten.me/json/<short URL without scheme> (the service fetches the short link)

terms.quote: You means the individual accessing or using the Service, or the company, or other legal entity on behalf of which such individual is accessing or using the Service, as applicable.
terms.reviewer: batch p9-G03-1 review (A1: published Terms and Conditions, last updated 2023-03-12; no clause restricts business or automated use of the keyless JSON API)

json_api.notes: Research C0175 (2026-11-25): keyless v1 JSON {requested_url, success, resolved_url, usage_count, remaining_calls}; free plan 10 new (uncached) lookups per hour per IP (plans page). The docs now describe a v2 token API (/api/v2/unshorten, Authorization: Token) - not wired (no key in the spec). Terms and Conditions at /terms-of-service (TermsFeed template, governed by the law of Nepal) apply to companies as users and do not restrict business or automated use. Submitted URLs are stored (privacy policy https://unshorten.me/privacy-policy): reuses_queries; the service fetches the short link: fetches_target.

notes: Owned by batch p9-G03-1 (P070 unshorten_me). Never default (tier unknown: excluded at TLP:AMBER and above, --allow-unknown at CLEAR/GREEN; fetches_target).
